Guns of the later Ages, made from gunmetal, gun hearts and iron nets. Sidearms and the scatter gun come first, rifles and the belt-fed gun in Age VII, long guns, rockets and energy weapons with Rodos.

Light Sidearm: sidearm of Age VI. 5 hp a shot, 300 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 15 in the magazine, effective to 40 m, uses 9 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Heavy Sidearm: sidearm of Age VI. 6.5 hp a shot, 240 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 8 in the magazine, effective to 40 m, uses .45 Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Magnum Revolver: sidearm of Age VI. 10 hp a shot, 100 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 6 in the magazine, effective to 55 m, uses Magnum Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Compact Submachine Gun: submachine gun of Age VII. 4 hp a shot, 600 rounds a minute, automatic, 30 in the magazine, effective to 30 m, uses 9 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Carbine: rifle of Age VII. 6 hp a shot, 400 rounds a minute, automatic, 30 in the magazine, effective to 70 m, uses 5.56 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Assault Rifle: rifle of Age VII. 8 hp a shot, 300 rounds a minute, automatic, 30 in the magazine, effective to 75 m, uses 7.62 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Marksman Rifle: rifle of Age VII. 12 hp a shot, 150 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 20 in the magazine, effective to 110 m, uses 7.62 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Sniper Rifle: long-range rifle of Age VII. 22 hp a shot, 40 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 5 in the magazine, effective to 160 m, uses 7.62 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Anti-Materiel Rifle: long-range rifle of Age RODOS. 34 hp a shot, 30 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 5 in the magazine, effective to 200 m, uses .50 Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Pump Shotgun: scatter gun of Age VI. 2.5 hp x8 pellets a shot, 60 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 6 in the magazine, effective to 25 m, uses 12 Gauge Shell. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Combat Shotgun: scatter gun of Age VII. 2.5 hp x8 pellets a shot, 120 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 8 in the magazine, effective to 25 m, uses 12 Gauge Shell. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Automatic Shotgun: scatter gun of Age VII. 2.2 hp x8 pellets a shot, 240 rounds a minute, automatic, 20 in the magazine, effective to 22 m, uses 12 Gauge Shell. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Light Machine Gun: belt-fed gun of Age VII. 5.5 hp a shot, 400 rounds a minute, automatic, 100 in the magazine, effective to 70 m, uses 5.56 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Rotary Minigun: belt-fed gun of Age RODOS. 6 hp a shot, 1200 rounds a minute, automatic, 200 in the magazine, effective to 60 m, uses 7.62 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Grenade Launcher: launcher of Age VII. 12 hp a shot, 50 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 6 in the magazine, effective to 60 m, uses 40 mm Grenade. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Rocket Launcher: launcher of Age RODOS. 25 hp a shot, 24 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 1 in the magazine, effective to 90 m, uses Rocket. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Energy Rifle: energy weapon of Age RODOS. 9 hp a shot, 200 rounds a minute, automatic, 24 in the magazine, effective to 90 m, uses Energy Cell. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

Red Dot Sight: zooms the view 1.25x while sneaking. One of each kind per gun.
Four-Power Scope: zooms the view 4x while sneaking. One of each kind per gun.
Eight-Power Scope: zooms the view 8x while sneaking. One of each kind per gun.
Suppressor: quietens the shot and trims damage by a tenth. One of each kind per gun.
Muzzle Brake: cuts recoil by two fifths. One of each kind per gun.
Foregrip: tightens spread by three tenths. One of each kind per gun.
